test_zip_with_all_true_mask: test the zip_with method with an all-true boolean mask selecting all values from the first series
test_zip_with_all_false_mask: test the zip_with method with an all-false boolean mask selecting all values from the second series
test_zip_with_mixed_mask: test the zip_with method with a mixed boolean mask interleaving values from two series
test_zip_with_series_comparison: test the zip_with method using a series comparison expression as the boolean mask
test_zip_with_null_values: test the zip_with method preserves null values when merging two series with a mask
